title: DirectPrediction
description: DIAGNOSTIC-ONLY record (added at the Phase 01 gate review, 2026-09-21): direct strike heads of a learned model WITHOUT a predicted trajectory, consumed by the harness's direct-head adapter to build StrikeCandidate(derivation = DIRECT_HEAD). Exists so that Phase 09 Task 09.8 (C-GBDT 'direct' evaluation mode) and Phase 19 AB-NOTRAJ can be represented without faking a trajectory. It is NEVER produced in the live application, never consumed by geometry, and never used by any Arm that is shipped (Phase 13 refuses it). The runtime contract remains trajectory-first (ADR-0007): TrajectoryPrediction is the primary output of every live Anticipator. docs/architecture/contracts.md section 3.11.

t_capture.description: Reference time t_ref: latest frame the model was allowed to see (causal).

model_hash.description: Always a learned model (source MODEL); rule-based anticipators have no direct mode.

diagnostic_mode.description: Which sanctioned diagnostic path produced this record. Any other use is a contract violation.

strike_prob_within_H.description: Head (i): probability of a valid impact within horizon_s of t_capture.

tti.description: Head (ii): predicted Time-to-Impact in seconds from t_capture; the adapter sets t_impact_pred = t_capture + tti. Null when the model emits no TTI (then no candidate can be built).

impact_pos.description: Optional direct impact-position head; the adapter uses the zone's impact-surface midpoint when null (documented in Phase 09).
